title: Austin's 1897 Year-End Budget Approvals
summary:
• **Fire Department Equipment Purchase**: Council approved spending $1,440 on 2,500 feet of fire hose to upgrade the city's firefighting capabilities.

• **Multiple Budget Appropriations Passed**: The council approved over $16,000 in spending, including funds for city salaries, bond interest payments, election expenses, and street department operations.

• **Aid for Families Moving to Mexico**: Council approved $35 to help pay for Pedro Guivita's family to relocate to Mexico, with the county covering the other half of railroad expenses.

• **Boundary Expansion Rejected**: A proposed ordinance to divide Austin into seven wards and expand the city was indefinitely postponed after councilmen voted against it, indicating hesitation about growth plans.

• **Committee Assignments Announced**: Mayor McCall announced standing committees for the upcoming year to oversee departments including Fire, Police, Water and Light, Parks, and other city services.
